title: Feature Delivery Forecast & Readiness Ledger
content:
Purpose:
A compact, action-oriented ledger to track sprint delivery forecasts, KPI variance against baseline, and a granular readiness checklist for the next feature rollout. Designed for cross-functional handoff (PM, Eng, SRE, CS) and to be machine-parsable for automation checks.

Scope:
- Applies to medium+ launches that require Dedicated capacity reservation or private deployment verification.
- Covers the sprint window from feature branch cut through 14 days post-general-rollout.

Milestones:
- Spec freeze: 2026-02-22
- Feature branch cut / integration window start: 2026-02-28
- Canary rollout: 2026-03-16
- General ramp start (Phase B): 2026-03-19
- Full availability: target 2026-03-25

Sprint forecast (2-week cadence):
Sprint | Committed Story Points | Predicted Ship % | Delta vs baseline
S46   | 36                       | 70%              | -12pp
S47   | 42                       | 85%              | -2pp
S48   | 28                       | 60%              | -25pp (risks: infra flakiness)

KPI definitions & thresholds (primary):
- Latency p95 (edge->model): target <= 480ms, alert > 650ms for 5m
- Error-rate (500s + model errors): target < 0.15%, critical > 0.5% -> immediate rollback
- Cost per request (tokens+infra): target <= $0.015, warn > $0.02
- Quality guardrail (automated eval): rerank F1 on eval-suite-v3 >= 0.82; drop triggers canary hold

Variance ledger (recent measurements):
- 2026-03-05: p95 512ms (+6.7% vs baseline), action: increase pre-warm by 1 GPU
- 2026-03-09: E2E test error-rate 0.12% (within threshold), note: retry storms observed in one region
- 2026-03-11: cost/request $0.017 (above target) - investigating batching config

Readiness gating checklist (required to progress to next phase):
1) PM sign-off on QA matrix (owner: Maya Chen) - DONE 2026-02-25
2) E2E test pass (>95% stable for 48h) (owner: Ethan Liu) - in_progress
3) Infra capacity reserved & cost commit (owner: Priya Desai) - action: reserve 4 GPUs us-west1 (due 2026-03-15)
4) SRE playbook populated + alert runbook (owner: Jordan Kim) - pending
5) Privacy & compliance review (owner: Sofie Andersson) - pending items documented
6) Docs & CS training checklist complete (owner: Customer Success lead) - partial

Risk register (top 5):
- R1: Autoscaler cooldown leads to underprovision during burst -> Mitigation: pre-warm 10% of projected burst and set min replicas=6
- R2: Model regression on long-tail queries -> Mitigation: gated A/B evaluation set, hold canary if F1 drops > 0.03
- R3: Cost overruns during ramp -> Mitigation: temporary traffic caps and fallback to quantized model variant
- R4: Data residency blocking private deployment -> Mitigation: schedule legal review and a phased in-region rollout plan
- R5: KV cache miss rates high on cold starts -> Mitigation: warm-up synthetic requests + cache seeding script (run 1h prior)

Contingency triggers & run actions (automated):
- Trigger A: p95 > 30% above baseline for 10m -> Action: divert 30% traffic to lower-cost model variant + page SRE
- Trigger B: error-rate > 0.5% -> Action: rollback last route change; auto-open incident and notify PM/CS leads
- Trigger C: cost/run > $0.03 for sustained 1h -> Action: throttle non-critical routes and start cost-mitigation playbook

Phased rollout plan & traffic schedule:
- Phase 0 (internal): 0-0.5% traffic for smoke, duration 4-8h
- Phase A (alpha partners): 0.5-5% traffic, duration 48h, acceptance on KPI gates
- Phase B (expanded beta): 5-25% traffic, duration 72h, monitor stability + quality
- Phase C (general): 25-100% traffic, ramp over 3 days with weekly checkpoints

Measurement & dashboarding notes:
- Dashboard slices: by model-variant, by region, by route, and by customer tier (hosted vs dedicated)
- Automations: Slack alert + PagerDuty for critical gates; Metricstore aggregation at 1m granularity for first 24h after each phase

Handoff notes (to SRE / Infra / CS):
- Expected steady qps: 900; peak qps: 2400 burst; CPU/GPU footprint: 6-18 GPUs depending on phase
- KV cache hit target: >=45% after warm-up; seed keys: list attached in Confluence doc
- CS enablement: one-pager + FAQ in /customer-success/carveouts by 2026-03-16

Open questions (to resolve before canary):
- Do we require a temporary SLO exemption for initial warm-up traffic? (owner: Jordan Kim)
- Is the embedding retention policy compatible with CSM demo data? (owner: Sofie Andersson)
- Should we use dedicated or mixed pool for alpha partners to reduce cross-tenant risk? (owner: Priya Desai)

Next steps & action owners:
- Priya: finalize capacity reservation and cost commit by 2026-03-15
- Ethan: complete E2E stability run 2026-03-14 and post results to linked artifact ENG-1234
- Jordan: author SRE playbook and PagerDuty runbook by 2026-03-17
- Maya: final go/no-go sync on 2026-03-20 10:00 PST (invite list: Eng leads, SRE, CS, Legal)

Version log (human-readable):
- 2026-02-18: created initial forecast & gating checklist (Maya)
- 2026-02-25: updated after QA sync; PM sign-off recorded
- 2026-03-05: perf test added variance entries; increased warm-up
- 2026-03-12: updated phased rollout percentages after cost review

Quick links & references:
- Spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PROD/feature-x-spec
- Runbook draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/rollout-runbook
- Github PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serve/pull/987

(Notes: this sheet is intentionally concise so it can be copied into ticket templates and referenced during daily standups. Use the "variance ledger" section to call out any deviations for retrospective.)
